windows: Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: These two supplements are in this protocol for repair, so don't use them as "trip enhancers."

In practice they can quickly change how strongly psychedelics hit you, so don't count on your usual dose acting the way it used to. 5-HTP is also what your body makes serotonin out of, so taking it on top of anything else that raises serotonin is how people end up with serotonin syndrome, which can be deadly (see the 5-HTP section).
So never take it with any of these: SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs, linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St.

John's wort, SAM-e or L-tryptophan. Rule: psychedelics act on serotonin too, so do not take 5-HTP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga, iboga microdoses included.

That's because ayahuasca's harmalas inhibit MAO-A, which amplifies the serotonin load, while ibogaine and noribogaine interact with serotonin transport themselves, on top of the serious cardiac and neurological risk iboga already carries.

pair-cog-proj7.headline: AI Detected
windows: Cognitive Warning: As you de-armor, you will feel more naked and exposed than you're used to, and you'll assume everyone can see your anxiety, when really they notice far less of it than you think (Dr.
Nicholas Epley calls this the "Illusion of Transparency" in his book Mindwise).
Your armored brain also reads the threat it feels into neutral faces, so you will think people are judging you when they're mostly just thinking about themselves.

So during this protocol, do not trust your social intuition: assume you are misreading every room, at least until your heart rate is back down to your usual resting rate, and under 90 BPM, since a racing heart means your reasoning brain is offline (see the "Metabolic Red Line" below).

agm6.headline: AI Generated
windows: Agmatine Warning (The Voltage Governor): Agmatine is optional in this protocol, and it's sold as a supplement, but don't think of it as a basic nutrient like magnesium or a membrane nutrient like phosphatidylcholine. It's a neuromodulator, and it works on a lot at once: NMDA/glutamate signaling, imidazoline/alpha-2 adrenergic tone, nitric-oxide pathways, and the reward and tolerance you get from opioids. So it can clash with the drugs that work on those same systems, which is what the precautions below are for.

pair-iso-rule6.headline: AI Generated
windows:
Behavioral Warning (The Isolation Trap): This protocol demands starving your brain of "Phasic" Dopamine (excitement, novelty, the chase), and the easiest way to do that is to hole up alone, but do not isolate completely. Total social isolation spikes cortisol, the chronic stress hormone, which makes your brain more sensitive to glutamate, and that locks the armor in place whether or not you've ever had an addiction. We're social animals, so what you need is the calm kind of company, the kind that gives you oxytocin instead of a dopamine spike (the "Oxytocinergic Anchoring" the rule below is about).
The Rule: Seek "Boring Love", meaning parallel play (like reading next to someone) and touch that feels safe. As tempting as "Exciting Love" is (romance, high-stakes drama), avoid it, since it spikes Phasic Dopamine and puts the armor right back up.

windows: DMSO Safety: This protocol has you smell DMSO for anxiety and brain fog. It's a solvent that goes straight through your skin and lungs into your blood, and it can carry in whatever else is in the bottle or on your skin. So you should use 99.9% Pharmaceutical Grade DMSO, ideally in a glass bottle, since it can leach chemicals out of some plastics. It's sold on Amazon and other sites (I've never had a bad batch). Before using it, wash any lotions or other products off your hands and nose. Your lungs count too, so if you're a smoker, breathe in only a little at a time, since it can pull the tar from your lungs into your blood, and stop if you feel weak right afterwards, which is the first sign of that (there's more on all this in my full DMSO reference).
